title: 第18章 看来又是走后门进来的第19章 看来是走后门的
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 苏族。
东荒顶级势力。
落坐在东荒的西南方位，统辖万里疆域，掌控著成百上千的皇朝和宗门，更是拥有著分支，盘幽城苏家便是其中之一。
一处僻静的山峰半山腰。
一位长相英俊的青年，盘膝坐在巨石上，双手不断地结印，正在修炼七杀剑诀。
苏昊，当年剥夺苏辰的帝骨，並且自身天赋也很是逆天，被苏族誉为第一天才，觉醒的血轮为七杀剑血轮。
能够以血轮繁衍属於自己的武学，本身已经说明很多问题。
这次前往天罚森林，获得机缘，修为已经顺利突破到中级金丹境。
体內的力量奔腾如海的疯狂涌出，头顶上凝聚出的血轮，里面有著一柄红黑色剑，散发著可怕的杀意。
“七杀归位，破！”
体內凝聚的金丹，越发地凝实起来，瞬间突破自身极限，从中级金丹境顺利晋级到高级金丹境。
此时。
一道黑影突然凝聚而出，单膝跪地，说道：“少主，盘幽城传来消息，苏辰已经被逐出家族。”
很是满意地点点头，原本苏辰在他眼里，就是螻蚁一般的存在。
以他的身份和实力，只要动动手指头，便可以顺利捏死苏辰，绝对没有丝毫的悬念。
但是。
苏昊在天罚森林却没有出手，他就喜欢那种高高俯视的感觉，让苏辰生不如死。
（请记住101??????.??????网站，观看最快的章节更新）
“派人羞辱，记住，不要杀了他。”
黑影瞬间消失得无影无踪。
修为刚刚突破到高级金丹境，並未浪费时间，缓缓闭上双眼，开始衝击巔峰金丹境。
经过五天的全力赶路，苏辰终於进入东荒学院的地域范围。
无比巨大的山谷，四周笼罩著淡淡白雾，远远望去，宛如落坐在白云之巔。
山谷入口。
有著一块牌匾，上面写著四个字『东荒学院』，正是闻名东荒的东荒学院。
东荒学院整体实力和底蕴很强，最重要的是，东荒学院屹立东荒多年，最根本的原因在於，学院培养的武者有很多成为东荒强者，甚至离开东荒前往大陆。
没有任何的势力，愿意招惹东荒学院。
当年的苏战，被誉为东荒第一强者，对於东荒学院院长有恩。
也正是因为如此。
苏渊才求助於东荒学院，让苏辰前来东荒学院修炼，也算是避让苏族。
“这位学员，请拿出你的身份玉牌。”
“老师你好，我叫苏辰，乃是学院的新学员，今天前来报导。”
坐在门口的中年男子，点点头，说道：“入学时间已经过了。”
“路上有事耽搁了。”
取出册子，男子一一查了起来，足足查了半个时辰，才收起册子说道：“苏辰，这是你的身份玉牌，你被安排在二十二初级班。”
“谢谢。”
content_en:
Sioux.
The top force in the Eastern Wasteland.
Located in the southwest of the Eastern Wasteland, it governs thousands of miles of territory, controls hundreds of dynasties and sects, and even has branches. The Su family in Panyou City is one of them.
A secluded mountain halfway up the mountain.
A handsome young man was sitting cross-legged on a boulder, his hands constantly forming seals, and he was practicing the Seven Kills Sword Technique.
Su Hao was deprived of Su Chen's imperial bones, and his own talent was incredible. He was hailed as the number one genius by the Su clan. His awakened blood wheel was the Seven Killing Sword blood wheel.
Being able to reproduce one's own martial arts with blood wheels already explains a lot.
This time I went to the Heavenly Punishment Forest and got a chance, and my cultivation level has successfully broken through to the intermediate golden elixir realm.
The power in his body rushed out like a sea, and the blood wheel condensed on his head contained a red and black sword, exuding terrifying killing intent.
"Seven kills return to position, break!"
The golden elixir condensed in the body became more and more solid, breaking through its own limit in an instant, and successfully promoted from the intermediate golden elixir realm to the advanced golden elixir realm.
at this time.
A black shadow suddenly condensed out, knelt down on one knee, and said: "Young Master, there is news from Panyou City that Su Chen has been expelled from the family."
He nodded with satisfaction. In his eyes, Su Chen was like an ant.
With his identity and strength, he could successfully crush Su Chen to death with just a few moves of his fingers, without any suspense.
but.
Su Hao did not take action in the Forest of Punishment. He liked the feeling of looking down from above, which made Su Chen's life worse than death.
(Please remember the 101??????.?????? website to watch the fastest chapter updates)
"Send someone to humiliate him, remember, don't kill him."
"Yes."
The black shadow instantly disappeared without a trace.
The cultivation base had just broken through to the advanced golden elixir realm, so he did not waste time. He slowly closed his eyes and began to attack the peak golden elixir realm.
~~~~~~~~
After five days of hard work, Su Chen finally entered the territory of Donghuang College.
The extremely huge valley is surrounded by a light white mist. Looking from a distance, it looks like it is sitting on the top of white clouds.
Valley entrance.
There is a plaque with four words written on it: "Donghuang College", which is the famous Donghuang College in Donghuang.
The overall strength and foundation of Donghuang College is very strong. The most important thing is that Donghuang College has stood in Donghuang for many years. The most fundamental reason is that many warriors trained by the college have become strong men in Donghuang and even left Donghuang for the mainland.
No force is willing to provoke Donghuang College.
At that time, Su Zhan was known as the strongest man in the East Wasteland and was kind to the dean of the East Wasteland College.
It is precisely because of this.
Su Yuancai turned to Donghuang College for help and asked Su Chen to come to Donghuang College to practice, which could be regarded as avoiding the Su clan.
"This student, please take out your identity jade badge."
"Hello, teacher, my name is Su Chen. I am a new student of the academy. I am here to report today."
The middle-aged man sitting at the door nodded and said, "The enrollment time has passed."
"Something delayed me on the way."
Taking out the booklet, the man checked them one by one. After checking for half an hour, he put the book away and said, "Su Chen, this is your identity badge. You are placed in the 22nd junior class."
"Thank you."
